svg.text: Set size, pay and lower courts

text.tspan: Text edges change only by Article V. Two amendments in the model move
them. In 2026 both are in force.

svg.text: Senators are chosen by the People,
The President nominates a Vice President;

text.tspan: Agencies and lower courts exist only by statute (dashed edges). Congress
can enact an edge the text forbids. Once someone sues, the court strikes
Congress removes an officer who executes the laws

Seila Law (2020); Trump v. Slaughter (2026) · the head serves at will

in gov-tla. The founding graph (1789, with the Bill of Rights) is the initial state TLC computes; each amendment ratified by 2026, XVII (1913), XXV (1967), is
step rewrites it. The model treats no other amendment as changing the graph. Judicial review is Marbury's reading of Articles III and VI, not text. Vote
thresholds and persons are abstracted away. A model for study, not legal advice.
